mission_dimensions.track_definition: mission.md section 5: Track A = variant-independent WWOX loss of function; Track B = variant or allele-class specific (e.g. the Q230P missense class); Track C = repurposing, which is a method of reaching A or B, not a third lesion class
mission_dimensions.route_definition: RECUPERO_PROFONDO = deep recovery of the lost function; BENEFICIO_PRECOCE = concrete partial benefit, symptomatic control or protection of function, with paediatric feasibility and time in view

p4_card.identity: Glial-reactivity modulators as a class: IL-1 axis agents (an IL-1 receptor antagonist, IL-1beta antibodies, caspase-1 and NLRP3 inhibitors), JAK-STAT inhibitors, tetracycline-class microglial modulators. No compound is carded; the card exists to record what the WWOX record does and does not let this class be aimed at.
p4_card.indication_and_transfer: Only IF glial reactivity is (a) real in a seizing WWOX brain, (b) not just a seizure consequence that would resolve with seizure control and (c) causally harmful rather than protective. None of the three is established. Every precedent is from acute or acquired inflammation in a normally developing brain; the WWOX lesion is congenital and neuron-intrinsic.
p4_card.novelty_for_woree: New in this cycle: (1) the rat and mouse glial signs conflict and the authors of the rat paper say so; the rat deficit is present from the first age measured (PND 5, about half of wild type), earlier than the strain's sound-evoked seizures (after PND 16), while the null mouse excess is read at P14 to P20, when the first recordings of spikes begin (about P14): no study reads glia and EEG in the same animals over the days that separate the two. (2) Microglia carry no detectable Wwox in the rat; the astroglial conditional deletion was scored only for delay, weight and survival. (3) In the human organoid, without microglia or behavioural seizures, no reactive-astrocyte programme appears (descriptive, 4 v 2 libraries). (4) The deposited thresholded tables of the P47T mouse do not list Gfap, Aif1, Il1b, Tnf, Il6 or Lcn2: the regulator-level inflammatory inference there does not rest on those canonical transcripts (absence from a thresholded list is not a measurement). (5) The need's compound list could not reach the two IL-1-axis agents that have epilepsy exposure, because their targets (the IL-1 receptor and caspase-1) were not on the need.
p4_card.state_of_known_roads: needs.json NEED-NEUROINFLAMMATION-GLIA; map R-06 and M10; HYP-20260705-02 (JAK2/STAT3 bridge, id only); DL-REPO-002.
p4_card.pathway_and_objective: BENEFICIO_PRECOCE if ever; the first use of this thread is as a readout (is gliosis a seizure-independent early marker?), the lever question follows only if the answer is yes.
p4_card.mechanism: Target (if pursued): IL1R1, IL1B, CASP1, NLRP3, JAK2 and STAT3 in glia. Direction wanted: less reactive-glia signalling, only if the cause-versus-consequence experiment says glia are upstream of any measured harm. The causal compartment of the phenotype is neuronal (neuron-restricted deletion reproduces it, neuron-restricted gene replacement reverses it), so a glial drug is not expected to touch the cause.

for: Gliosis is raised in the null mouse (P14 hippocampus, P20 tissue) and the P47T homozygote (progressive astrogliosis), and neuron-restricted rescue returns GFAP-positive cells from about 44 to about 5.
A regulator-level inflammatory signature is positive in three forebrain regions of the P47T homozygote.
In a seizing genetic DEE mouse (Scn1a+/-) astroglial GFAP is raised from the aggravation phase onward (abstract), a precedent that glial change in a genetic DEE can be tracked against disease stage.
against: The rat Wwox-mutant cortex has about half the GFAP-positive and Iba1-positive cells of wild type from PND 5, the opposite sign, and the authors state it.
The human organoid shows no reactive programme, and no microglia.
Microglia carry no detectable Wwox (rat); the glial excess is therefore non-cell-autonomous for that cell type; astrocyte-specific deletion was not scored for gliosis.
The same neuron-restricted rescue that lowers GFAP also stops seizures and restores survival: the data cannot assign the fall to a glial route.

The IL-1-axis precedents are acute or post-infectious: anakinra in cryptogenic NORSE/FIRES showed no demonstrated long-term outcome benefit (14 patients, retrospective); minocycline in chronic FIRES produced no significant change in seizure frequency in three patients; VX-765 did not meet its phase II primary endpoint and had no effect in a rat infantile-spasms model.

Glial direction is context-dependent in the abstracts read: STAT3 removal reduced glial activation and damage in neonatal hypoxia-ischaemia (Hristova 2016) and astrocyte uncoupling preceded seizures in a temporal-lobe-epilepsy model (Bedner 2015), so glial change can be upstream of seizures and a glial lever is not simply less gliosis; the commonly stated protective role of reactive astrocytes was not verified here.
evidence_for_and_against.transfer_limits: Acute or acquired inflammation, immune-mediated syndromes and adult injury models against a congenital neuron-intrinsic loss; mouse and rat against human; null and missense WW-domain alleles against a catalytic-domain missense allele, for which no glial datum exists; chronic adult P47T against the three-week null.

p4_card.pharmacology: Not assessed: no compound is carded. Catalogue reach was measured instead (see the cycle README): the need as written reached IL1B, NLRP3, JAK2, TNF, NFKB1 and RELA but not IL1R1 or CASP1.

scope_of_checks.card_inferences_owed_audit: Every statement marked INFERENZA, the organoid panel and every card-level synthesis, is owed a blind audit by someone other than the producer.

p4_card.predictions: Registered in the cycle README before any further data: if gliosis is a consequence of seizure-network activity, glial density in the null mouse is NOT above wild type before the first recorded spike and rises after it; if glial maturation is delayed first (the rat picture) the density is BELOW wild type before the first spike and crosses above it after seizures begin; if a neuron-derived seizure-independent signal drives it, the density is above wild type before the first spike. One time course with simultaneous recordings separates the three.
p4_card.next_measurement: Wet-lab, not done: Wwox-null (or neuron-restricted deletion) pups with wild-type littermates; GFAP and Iba1 density and area fraction in cortex and in hippocampus at P5, P8, P11, P14 and P17 on the same sections for both species-comparable readouts, with continuous cortical recording from the earliest age at which an electrode can be placed, each animal classified as before or after its first spike; controls: wild type at every age, neuron-restricted vector-treated pups; discriminating result: the sign of the glial difference before the first spike. A compound arm is not designed here.
p4_card.value_added: Replaces 'glial activation is increased in two models' by a measured conflict of sign across species with a stated discriminating design, shows the human organoid carries no reactive programme, and shows that the catalogue links of the need pointed at the wrong end of the IL-1 axis.
p4_card.clinical_census: Clinical census, ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, 2026-10-20 (drug_repurposing/clinical_census_20261020.md): no registered WOREE interventional study; it answers seven queries against one registry on one date and a missing hit does not prove that no study exists. Not re-run for this card.

card_conventions: IPOTESI throughout; the bridge forces it. No score, rank, probability or blended index is carried.
directional_summary compares signs only where target, endpoint and every context dimension match; UNRESOLVED is a statement about the record, not about the biology.
Every external row is NOT WWOX EVIDENCE; the organoid row is an exploratory transcript analysis of one deposit.
Abstract-level statements from PubMed are labelled abstract only; none carries a receipt.
label_lookup is NOT_ATTEMPTED in the bridge: the bridge has no network.
No dose, route, schedule or paediatric suitability appears.

abstention_card.missing_datum: Glial density and area fraction measured over the days before and after the first recorded spike in the same Wwox-deficient animals, and any glial endpoint after any compound in a Wwox-deficient system; never done.
abstention_card.search_record: PubMed 2026-10-29: WWOX[tiab] with astrocyte, microglia, gliosis, neuroinflammation, oligodendrocyte or myelin returned 15 records, all assessed against the registry (manifests exist for the glial rows used); WWOX[tiab] with oxidative, ROS, redox, superoxide, glutathione, NRF2 or ferroptosis returned 26 records (redox thread, not taken). External: anakinra with FIRES/NORSE, VX-765 or caspase-1 inhibitors in epilepsy, minocycline with seizures, astrocyte STAT3 with seizures, adenosine kinase with astrogliosis, glial change preceding seizures in genetic epilepsy. Catalogue: repurposing_search need, target (IL1B, NLRP3, JAK2, TNF, NFKB1, IL1R1, CASP1, CSF1R, IL6R, ADK, GSDMD) and compound (anakinra, canakinumab, dapansutrile, ruxolitinib, baricitinib, minocycline, ibudilast, belnacasan, pexidartinib, MCC950, disulfiram, tocilizumab, fingolimod). Reopening condition: a time course of glial density against first spike in a Wwox-deficient model, or a glial endpoint under any compound.

VX-765 phase II and a rat infantile-spasms model (abstract)
abstention_card.an_abstention_is_a_result: The need stays 'uncertain' but is narrowed: gliosis is carried first as a readout with a measured sign conflict; a lever question opens only if glia are found upstream of a measured harm.
